# indiecode Software Solutions

> indiecode is a premier software development and digital engineering firm specializing in bespoke enterprise software, full-stack web and mobile apps, scalable cloud infrastructure, and AI automation—shipped in weeks.

## About indiecode
indiecode partners with ambitious startups, high-growth scale-ups, and established enterprises to architect, engineer, and deploy high-performance digital products. Headquartered in Nashik, Maharashtra, India, indiecode serves a global clientele across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

- **Website:** https://indiecode.in
- **Email:** hello@indiecode.in
- **Phone:** +91 91563 67501
- **Location:** Nashik, Maharashtra, India
- **Leadership:** Pranav Patil (Founder), Rohan Baviskar (Founding Director)

---

## Core Engineering Services

### 1. Custom Software Development
- Tailored web platforms, business management systems, and internal operational portals.
- End-to-end architecture from product discovery to production launch.
- Clean, maintainable architectures designed around client-specific workflows.
- [Learn more about Custom Software](https://indiecode.in/#services)

### 2. Automation & Integrations
- Intelligent workflow automation, ETL pipelines, and API integrations.
- CRM, ERP, and payment gateway synchronizations (Stripe, Razorpay, Salesforce, HubSpot).
- AI agent and automated decision-making pipelines.
- [Learn more about Automation & Integrations](https://indiecode.in/#services)

### 3. Cloud & Scalable Infrastructure
- Resilient cloud deployment on AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure.
- Microservices, serverless computing, container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
- CI/CD automation, zero-downtime deployments, and cloud security hardening.
- [Learn more about Cloud Infrastructure](https://indiecode.in/#services)

### 4. Enterprise Web & Mobile Applications
- High-velocity React, Next.js, and Node.js web applications.
- Cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android.
- High-performance, low-latency UI/UX with responsive typography and accessibility compliance.
- [Learn more about Solutions](https://indiecode.in/#solutions)

## Industry Verticals
indiecode delivers custom digital solutions tailored to complex business domains:
- **Finance & FinTech:** Secure transaction pipelines, lending platforms, compliance workflows.
- **Logistics & Supply Chain:** Real-time tracking, fleet telemetry, inventory automation.
- **Healthcare & MedTech:** Telemedicine, HIPAA-compliant patient management, diagnostic portals.
- **Education & EdTech:** Interactive LMS, live classrooms, assessment engines.
- **E-Commerce & Retail:** Custom headless storefronts, multi-vendor marketplaces, POS integrations.
- [View Industries](https://indiecode.in/#industries)

---

## Technical Capabilities & Stack
- **Frontend:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Modern Vanilla CSS, TailwindCSS, Progressive Web Apps (PWA).
- **Backend & APIs:** Node.js, Express, Python (FastAPI, Django), Go, RESTful APIs, GraphQL.
- **Databases:** PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Supabase, Firebase.
- **AI & ML Integrations:** OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, LlamaIndex, vector embeddings, autonomous agents.
- **DevOps & Cloud:** Docker, Kubernetes, AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, CloudFront), Vercel, Cloudflare, CI/CD.
- **Security & Quality:** OWASP Top 10 standards, automated SAST linting, SOC2 compliance readiness, bilateral non-disclosure agreements (NDAs).
